title: Accounts Set-Off Note on Revision Overage Charges
content:
# Accounts Set-Off Note on Revision Overage Charges

Where a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is closed at the customer's request, the share of the charges for revisions beyond the included allowance that is set off against the refund turns on whether such a charge stands booked on the commission and on what the customer still owes on it.

## The shares set off

| Where | Set off against the refund |
|---|---|
| A charge for a revision beyond the included allowance stands booked on the commission and what the customer still owes on the commission stands above those charges | The whole of them, that is 100 per cent |
| Such a charge stands booked and what the customer still owes stands at or below those charges | 50 per cent of them |
| Otherwise | Nothing is set off for revisions beyond the included allowance |

A charge for a revision beyond the included allowance stands booked where the commission's entries under the revision overage reason come to more than nothing. What the customer still owes on the commission is the balance standing on the commission record.

## Readings (hypothetical)

With USD 500.00 of charges for revisions beyond the included allowance standing on the commission:

- What the customer still owes stands at USD 900.00, above those charges: USD 500.00 is set off.
- What the customer still owes stands at USD 500.00, equal to those charges: USD 250.00 is set off.
- What the customer still owes stands at USD 200.00, below those charges: USD 250.00 is set off.
- No such charge stands booked: nothing is set off for revisions beyond the included allowance.
